_comment: Raftel AE — Alibaba Cloud ECS configuration template. Copy to config.json and fill in your account details.
_paper_spec: Paper §7.1: 8 vCPU / 32 GB RAM, 1 replica per instance, Ubuntu 20.04 x86-64, Intel SGX hardware enclave. The paper describes 10 Gbps; current g7t.2xlarge documentation lists 5 Gbit/s baseline and up to 10 Gbit/s burst.
_region_note: Choose a region/zone where ecs.g7t.2xlarge has stock. All instances must share one VSwitch. The type provides 5 Gbit/s baseline and up to 10 Gbit/s burst bandwidth.
_credentials_note: Prefer ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID and ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET environment variables. Never commit credentials.
_instance_type_note: SGX-capable, 8 vCPU / 32 GB / 16 GiB encrypted memory. TrustedSystemMode=vTPM is a separate trusted-boot setting and is not proof that an SGX enclave ran.
_instance_count_note: Default 7 replica hosts for Simulation mode. Full paper topology: fig3 and fig4 need up to 97 replicas (f=32, 3f+1); fig6 needs 25. An off-VPC launcher adds one runner.
_image_note: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS x86-64. Find the latest image ID for your region: aliyun ecs DescribeImages --RegionId YOUR_REGION --OSType linux --Architecture x86_64 | grep ubuntu_20
_security_group_note: Allow SSH 22 only from the launcher public IP; allow TCP 8760-9800 and ICMP between members of this security group/VSwitch.
_key_pair_note: Import aliyun/raftel-ae.pem.pub as this regional key pair. The private key is ignored by Git and must stay chmod 600.
_vswitch_note: All instances must use the same VSwitch and availability zone. Replica traffic uses private IPs; public IPs are only for SSH from the off-cloud launcher.
_runner_note: When launching outside the VPC, provision one extra g7t runner for HW builds and clients. --count remains the replica count.
